scan.--format: Specify report format (json, yaml, sarif, gitlab-sast, rdjson, html)
scan.-f: Specify report format (json, yaml, sarif, gitlab-sast, rdjson, html)
scan.--include-stats: Include language usage statistics in reports that support them.
scan.--no-extract: Do not include code extract in report.
scan.--no-rule-meta: Do not include rule description content.
scan.--output: Specify the output path for the report.
scan.--report: Specify the type of report (security, privacy, dataflow). (default "security")
scan.--severity: Specify which severities are included in the report. (default "critical,high,medium,low,warning")
scan.--disable-default-rules: Disables all default and built-in rules.
scan.--only-rule: Specify the comma-separated ids of the rules you would like to run. Skips all other rules.
scan.--skip-rule: Specify the comma-separated ids of the rules you would like to skip. Runs all other rules.
scan.--context: Expand context of schema classification e.g., --context=health, to include data types particular to health
scan.--data-subject-mapping: Override default data subject mapping by providing a path to a custom mapping JSON file
scan.--diff: Only report differences in findings relative to a base branch.
scan.--disable-domain-resolution: Do not attempt to resolve detected domains during classification (default true)
scan.--domain-resolution-timeout: Set timeout when attempting to resolve detected domains during classification, e.g. --domain-resolution-timeout=3s (default 3s)
scan.--exit-code: Force a given exit code for the scan command. Set this to 0 (success) to always return a success exit code despite any findings from the scan. (default -1)
scan.--external-rule-dir: Specify directories paths that contain .yaml files with external rules configuration
scan.--force: Disable the cache and runs the detections again
scan.--internal-domains: Define regular expressions for better classification of private or unreachable domains e.g. --internal-domains=".*.my-company.com,private.sh"
scan.--parallel: Specify the amount of parallelism to use during the scan
scan.--scanner: Specify which scanner to use e.g. --scanner=secrets, --scanner=secrets,sast (default [sast])
scan.--skip-git-ignore: Scan files even if their paths match patterns in .gitignore
scan.--skip-path: Specify the comma separated files and directories to skip. Supports * syntax, e.g. --skip-path users/*.go,users/admin.sql
scan.--skip-test: Disable automatic skipping of test files (default true)
scan.--config-file: Load configuration from the specified path. (default "bearer.yml")
scan.--ignore-file: Load ignore file from the specified path. (default "bearer.ignore")
scan.--log-level: Set log level (error, info, debug, trace) (default "info")

ignore.--author: Add author information to this ignored finding. (default output of "git config user.name")
ignore.-a: Add author information to this ignored finding. (default output of "git config user.name")
ignore.--comment: Add a comment to this ignored finding.
ignore.--false-positive: Mark an this ignored finding as false positive.
ignore.--config-file: Load configuration from the specified path. (default "bearer.yml")
ignore.--ignore-file: Load ignore file from the specified path. (default "bearer.ignore")
ignore.--log-level: Set log level (error, info, debug, trace) (default "info")
